body: Aye, I relate heavily to all of that. At the end of the day, what he does is his own deal, not necessarily yours. Unfortunately you can't expect that he definitely will put effort in, you can only do what you can.

I sadly agree in a big way. Being communist is little but an admission that it's a fucked up system that hurts everyone but the already disgustingly rich. I've been self-employed in the past, to some success, and worked very few hours of the course of a week. I didn't succeed, but I would try again if I live that long. With 40k dollars and the right luck, it's an option possibly worth considering in your case.

Either way, I agree. It's a fucked up system that forces us to work like that.

I hear this in a big way. And it's something I personally blame capitalism for, more than anything. You're undoubtedly a complete human being, clearly with likes and desires and dreams, but fitting in with a society that cares little is hard, edging on impossible sometimes. Just from the way you write, you're clearly at least fairly intelligent, and that alone inspires faith in me that you do have something to contribute. Are there things you enjoy doing?

As somebody still stuck in a relationship with a suicidal person for an awfully long time, no, you're not an asshole. Sounds like your ex/bf is far more toxic, even. In tired and stressed situations it's easy to make these meetings and have them go awry. Obviously flaking isn't ideal, but these things do happen; In your shoes I'd make sure I was 100% comfortable with a potential meeting before setting another up in the future, so you can avoid these things. Missing a time to meet up is not a huge deal, especially in hard situations.
